name: A Vanity item whose script answers the use is collected before the script spends it
contract: Only a soulbound copy of a VanityCollection.dbc item is collected, and an item use collected it in
OnPlayerCanCastItemUseSpell. Feather of Ancients (item_ascension_feather_of_ancients) and the Ethereal Bazaar set
caches (item_ethereal_set_cache) answer the use in their own ItemScript, so that hook never ran and a bound copy
nothing had collected yet was destroyed without entering the Vanity collection.
Expected: using Feather of Ancients 977025 (spell 18282) or set cache 1001854 Aspiring Aspirant's Vestments
(spell 60034) adds it to the account's Vanity collection while the item is spent. forget_vanity removes the row
first, as for copies bound before anything collected them.

steps.label: Control: storing the bound feather collects it
SETUP: the feather is no longer collected
The feather is spent on the flight paths
DISCRIMINATING: the used feather is in the Vanity collection
Carry the Aspiring Aspirant's Vestments set cache
SETUP: the set cache is soulbound
SETUP: the set cache is not collected
DISCRIMINATING: the opened set cache is in the Vanity collection
